stories.summary: An advanced AI system has demonstrated the ability to independently improve a complex chemical reaction critical to medicinal chemistry. This breakthrough highlights the potential of AI to accelerate drug discovery and development.
stories.title: Near-Autonomous AI Chemist Enhances Medicinal Chemistry Reaction

stories.summary: OpenAI is rolling out premium seats for ChatGPT Business, offering enhanced capabilities or priority access for enterprise users. The update aims to improve performance and scalability for business customers.
stories.title: ChatGPT Business Introduces Premium Seats Feature

stories.summary: Researchers have built a machine‑learning system that can flag potentially fraudulent memecoins on the Solana blockchain before they execute rug‑pull schemes. The model analyzes token metadata, transaction patterns, and developer behavior to give investors and exchanges early warning of scams.
stories.title: Machine Learning Model Predicts Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana Ahead of Rug Pulls

stories.summary: Boston Children’s Hospital is using artificial intelligence to identify previously undiagnosed medical conditions in patients. The AI system analyzes complex clinical data to uncover patterns that lead to new diagnostic insights.
stories.title: Boston Children’s Hospital Leverages AI to Discover New Diagnoses

stories.summary: OpenAI and Broadcom have jointly developed a new chip designed to accelerate inference for large language models, aiming to improve efficiency and performance. The collaboration targets optimized hardware solutions for AI workloads.
stories.title: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil AI Chip Optimized for Large Language Models

stories.summary: Researchers have developed machine‑learning generated surrogate waveforms that accurately emulate gravitational‑wave signals, allowing for faster and more precise estimation of source parameters. The technique dramatically cuts the computational expense of traditional numerical‑relativity methods while preserving high fidelity.
stories.title: Machine-learning surrogate waveforms boost gravitational‑wave parameter estimation

stories.summary: Avatarin has developed a round-the-clock AI retail assistant powered by GPT-Realtime, enhancing customer service automation. The system leverages real-time conversational AI to handle inquiries and transactions continuously.
stories.title: Avatarin Deploys 24/7 AI Retail Agent Using GPT-Realtime

stories.summary: Pollen Robotics' Reachy Mini AI robot has transitioned to fully local processing, eliminating the need for cloud connectivity. This update enhances privacy, reduces latency, and enables autonomous operation in offline environments.
stories.title: Reachy Mini AI Robot Now Operates Fully Offline

stories.summary: DecoVAE is a new variational autoencoder (VAE) framework designed for efficient and interpretable probabilistic forecasting of time series data, combining trend and seasonal components. The model aims to improve accuracy while reducing computational overhead in real-world applications.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce DecoVAE: A Lightweight, Interpretable AI Model for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting

stories.summary: A long-standing software bug affecting AI systems was identified and resolved using core dump analysis, a method akin to epidemiological tracing. The fix addresses a vulnerability that persisted undetected for nearly two decades.
stories.title: Researchers Fix 18-Year-Old AI Bug Through Core Dump Epidemiology

stories.summary: Researchers have conducted a comprehensive audit of watermarking methods used to embed traceable signals in large language models, focusing on how these techniques perform across different languages. The analysis reveals notable disparities in detection accuracy and bias, prompting calls for more equitable watermarking standards worldwide.
stories.title: Study Audits Cross-Lingual Fairness of Language Model Watermarking Techniques

stories.summary: Researchers have unveiled an artificial intelligence system that analyzes data from wearable devices to rank potential biomarkers for disease detection. The tool aims to accelerate clinical research by streamlining the identification of clinically relevant signals from continuous health monitoring.
stories.title: New AI Platform Prioritizes Biomarker Candidates Using Wearable Sensor Data

stories.summary: Scientists have developed an artificial intelligence model that can automatically identify and count individual trees in high‑resolution satellite images, achieving unprecedented accuracy. The technology is expected to help governments and NGOs monitor forest health, verify carbon credits, and target reforestation projects more efficiently.
stories.title: AI System Accurately Counts Trees from Satellite Imagery to Boost Reforestation Efforts

stories.summary: Model ML demonstrates that GPT-5.6 Sol significantly improves efficiency in finance-related tasks. The advancement highlights AI's growing impact on specialized workflows.
stories.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Enhances Financial Work Efficiency, Model ML Reports

stories.summary: Asana leveraged AI, specifically Codex, to accelerate its engineering workflow, completing a backlog equivalent to five years of work in just two weeks. The move highlights the growing impact of AI on productivity in software development.
stories.title: Asana Uses AI to Complete 5 Years of Engineering Work in 2 Weeks

stories.summary: Researchers have introduced transformer-based models that provide interpretable predictions for clinical tasks using structured electronic health records. The models achieve higher accuracy while offering explanations that can aid clinicians in decision‑making.
stories.title: New Explainable Transformer Models Improve Clinical Predictions Using Structured EHR Data

stories.summary: A new artificial‑intelligence solution can automatically detect and categorize changes in electronic navigational charts, streamlining chart maintenance and enhancing maritime safety. The technology uses machine‑learning models trained on historic chart revisions to identify updates such as new hazards, depth adjustments, and regulatory modifications.
stories.title: AI System Introduced to Automate Classification of Electronic Navigational Chart Updates

stories.summary: A comprehensive review traces a decade‑and‑a‑half of artificial intelligence advances in video games, beginning with early Atari experiments and culminating in sophisticated systems used in the MMO EVE Online. The analysis highlights key breakthroughs, ongoing challenges, and future directions for AI-driven gameplay across the industry.
stories.title: 15 Years of Game AI Research: From Atari Classics to EVE Online

stories.summary: A coordinated influence campaign is promoting the 'Tech and Tariffs' narrative to shape US technology and trade policies. The effort appears aimed at swaying public and political opinion on AI and tech-related regulations.
stories.title: AI Influence Campaign Targets US Tech Policy with 'Tech and Tariffs' Narrative

stories.summary: Travelers has rolled out an AI-driven claims system across the U.S., leveraging OpenAI technology to streamline processing. The move aims to enhance efficiency and customer experience in insurance claims handling.
stories.title: Travelers Expands AI-Powered Claims Processing Nationwide Using OpenAI

stories.summary: Researchers have shown that feeding language models with human mobility patterns enables them to develop a richer, context‑aware sense of places. The approach improves location‑specific reasoning and could boost applications ranging from navigation assistants to regional content generation.
stories.title: Integrating Mobility Data Enhances Language Models' Geographic Understanding

stories.summary: NTT DATA Group has leveraged Codex AI to drastically cut incident analysis time to just 30 minutes, enhancing operational efficiency. The implementation highlights AI's growing role in streamlining IT and cybersecurity workflows.
stories.title: NTT DATA Group Reduces Incident Analysis Time to 30 Minutes Using Codex AI

stories.summary: A new study questions the supremacy of LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) in fine-tuning large language models, proposing alternative methods that may outperform it. The findings could reshape how developers optimize AI models for efficiency and accuracy.
stories.title: Researchers Challenge LoRA as the Dominant AI Fine-Tuning Technique

stories.summary: An AI agent autonomously designed a 3D virtual gallery of Paris by sequentially leveraging two Hugging Face Spaces. The demonstration highlights the potential of chaining AI models to achieve complex creative tasks.
stories.title: AI Agent Creates 3D Paris Gallery by Chaining Hugging Face Spaces

stories.summary: A new paper proposes Orthogonal JEPA, a method for factorized predictive states in latent world models, aiming to improve AI's understanding of complex environments. The approach builds on Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to enhance representation learning.
stories.title: Researchers Introduce Orthogonal JEPA for Advanced Latent World Models in AI

stories.summary: A new study finds that limiting visibility of training data in shared-genome language model societies improves compositional generalization. The approach suggests novel ways to train AI systems for better adaptability.
stories.title: Restricted Evidence Visibility Enhances Compositional Generalization in AI Language Models

stories.summary: Researchers propose a new framework, Multi-Method Causal Evidence Synthesis, to rank potential causal factors by combining convergent evidence from multiple observational methods. The approach aims to improve causal inference in complex systems where experimental data is limited.
stories.title: Study Introduces Multi-Method Approach to Rank Causal Drivers Using Observational Data

stories.summary: Deutsche Telekom is integrating AI to modernize its network and services, aiming to enhance efficiency and customer experience. The initiative highlights AI's growing role in reshaping the telecommunications industry.
stories.title: Deutsche Telekom Leverages AI to Transform Telecommunications

stories.summary: Agentic AI is transforming scientific computing by enabling autonomous problem-solving and adaptive workflows. Researchers and industries are leveraging these advancements to accelerate discovery and innovation.
stories.title: Scientific Computing Enters New Era with Agentic AI

stories.summary: Daybreak has introduced a new program called 'Patch the Planet' aimed at providing financial and operational support to open source software maintainers. The initiative seeks to sustain critical projects by addressing funding gaps and burnout in the open source community.
stories.title: Daybreak Launches 'Patch the Planet' Initiative to Support Open Source Maintainers

stories.summary: A new study introduces a methodology for auditing AI systems that modify themselves, comparing their gains to a rigorously defined null baseline. The approach aims to provide transparent metrics for tracking autonomous improvement and ensuring safety.
stories.title: Researchers unveil audit framework to measure self‑improving AI against baseline performance

stories.summary: Michigan is developing new infrastructure to advance AI capabilities, positioning itself as a hub for the emerging Intelligence Age. The initiative aims to support research, development, and deployment of AI technologies.
stories.title: Michigan Invests in AI Infrastructure to Support the Intelligence Age

stories.summary: Researchers propose methods to improve the accuracy of AI coding evaluations by filtering out irrelevant data. The findings aim to enhance benchmarking for AI-driven programming tools.
stories.title: New Study Addresses Challenges in Evaluating AI Coding Performance

stories.summary: Researchers have created an artificial‑intelligence system that can interpret brain activity recorded by non‑invasive EEG to determine the text a person is reading silently. The breakthrough opens possibilities for communication aids and cognitive research, while also raising potential privacy considerations.
stories.title: AI Model Decodes Silent Reading from Non‑Invasive EEG Signals

stories.summary: The SABET-QA model was introduced to tackle question answering over temporal knowledge graphs, allowing AI to reason about time‑dependent facts. Experiments show it outperforms prior methods on standard benchmarks, advancing research in temporal KG reasoning.
stories.title: Researchers unveil SABET-QA system for temporal knowledge graph question answering

stories.summary: A new leaderboard, FFASR, has been introduced to evaluate automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems under real-world conditions. The benchmark aims to provide more accurate and practical comparisons of ASR models.
stories.title: FFASR Leaderboard Launched to Benchmark Real-World Automatic Speech Recognition Performance

stories.summary: Researchers have introduced ContractScrub, a benchmark designed to evaluate AI systems' performance in the final review of legal contracts. The dataset aims to standardize testing and drive improvements in contract‑analysis tools.
stories.title: New AI Benchmark 'ContractScrub' Targets Final Review of Legal Contracts

stories.summary: Researchers unveiled a transformer‑style architecture that frames attention as relational interactions, using self‑queries and queries about other entities to capture complex dependencies. The approach, dubbed “Relation Is All You Need,” achieves state‑of‑the‑art performance on several benchmark tasks, demonstrating the power of pure relational modeling.
stories.title: New 'Relation Is All You Need' Model Enhances AI Reasoning with Self- and Cross-Entity Queries

stories.summary: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-Live, a new AI model or feature designed for real-time interactions. Details on its capabilities and release timeline remain limited.
stories.title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-Live

stories.summary: A new benchmark called OenoBench has been introduced to assess how well large language models can understand and reason about wine-related information. The dataset offers a suite of tasks—including classification, recommendation, and factual Q&A—to provide knowledge‑grounded evaluation of LLM performance in the specialized wine domain.
stories.title: Researchers Release OenoBench, a Wine-Domain Benchmark for Knowledge‑Grounded Evaluation of Large Language Models

stories.summary: Nvidia has disclosed a significant $21 billion investment in SpaceX, marking a major financial commitment between the AI chip leader and Elon Musk's aerospace company. The move underscores growing ties between tech and space industries.
stories.title: Nvidia Reveals $21 Billion Stake in SpaceX

stories.summary: A new agentic AI approach enables autonomous data gathering and dynamic modeling of travel behavior, improving accuracy in forecasting demand that varies with weather conditions. The method integrates active learning with domain-specific simulations, offering potential benefits for transportation planning and logistics.
stories.title: Researchers unveil agentic AI framework for active data collection, travel behavior modeling, and weather-sensitive demand prediction

stories.summary: OpenAI has positioned ChatGPT as a tool to assist with ambitious projects, enhancing productivity and creativity. The update highlights its evolving capabilities beyond basic queries to more complex, collaborative tasks.
stories.title: ChatGPT Expands Role as a Collaborative Work Partner

stories.summary: A new beginner-friendly guide explains how to use PyTorch's built-in profiler to analyze and optimize model performance. The first part of the series covers the basics of torch.profiler and its key features.
stories.title: PyTorch Profiling Guide Introduces torch.profiler for Beginners

stories.summary: Cisco and OpenAI have announced a collaboration to integrate Codex, OpenAI's AI coding tool, into enterprise engineering workflows. The partnership aims to enhance productivity and innovation in software development for businesses.
stories.title: Cisco and OpenAI Partner to Transform Enterprise Engineering with Codex

stories.summary: BBVA is embedding OpenAI's AI solutions at the heart of its banking operations to drive innovation. The partnership aims to transform customer experiences and internal processes through advanced AI capabilities.
stories.title: BBVA Integrates OpenAI Technology to Enhance Banking Services

stories.summary: Codex, an AI-powered coding assistant, is evolving into a broader productivity tool accessible to a wider audience. The shift aims to enhance efficiency beyond just developers, targeting general users.
stories.title: Codex Expands as a Universal Productivity Tool

stories.summary: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Work, a new tool designed to streamline and optimize data science workflows. The feature aims to assist professionals in tasks like data cleaning, analysis, and visualization.
stories.title: ChatGPT Work Enhances Data Science Workflows

stories.summary: The London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) is expanding its use of trusted AI to enhance data-driven decision-making processes. The initiative aims to leverage AI for more accurate and reliable insights in financial markets.
stories.title: LSEG Scales Trusted AI for Data-Driven Decision Making

stories.summary: Industry leaders share their views on shaping AI policy and the role of political advocacy in regulating emerging technologies. The discussion highlights the need for balanced frameworks to foster innovation while addressing ethical concerns.
stories.title: AI Policy and Political Advocacy: Perspectives from Industry Leaders
